adjudication.rationale: The new helper `parseRefreshTokenResponse` unconditionally sets `refreshTokenResponse.data.refresh_token = "refresh_token"` when the parsed response lacks a refresh token. Downstream code then uses the parsed `.data` to update/merge credentials (e.g. `office365calendar/lib/CalendarService.ts` spreads `tokenResponse.data` into `o365AuthCredentials`), which can overwrite a previously valid stored refresh token with the literal placeholder string. This is a real behavioral defect introduced by the diff. The finding’s “No test covers…” portion isn’t verifiable from the diff, but the underlying overwrite risk is.
